verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS financial platform like Wise Business, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers tracking controls, cookie or analytics opt-outs, or data-collection preferences; the items cover payments, cards, webhooks, the sandbox and versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
